name: Service Coverage
description: Maintains per-service radius maps over the tile grid — power, water, police, fire, schools — so that 'is this cell served?' is an O(1) lookup instead of a per-query distance scan against every building. Coverage maps are recomputed incrementally when a service structure is placed or removed, never on read, because in this genre reads (tooltips, growth checks, citizen happiness) outnumber writes (placements) by orders of magnitude. The component owns coverage geometry only: it does not simulate what a service does to its covered cells — utility consumption, crime, and education outcomes belong to whichever system consumes the coverage answer, and world.zone_planner's growth rules and world.citizen_agent_sim's satisfaction are expected consumers. It also does not visualize the radius; that overlay is a presentation concern for the build-mode UI that asks this component for the map.

inputs.name: services
inputs.description: Service definitions: id, coverage radius in tiles, and falloff curve. A linear falloff suits power; a hard radius suits police response.

inputs.name: gridResolution
inputs.description: Tiles per coverage sample. 1 is per-cell accuracy; 4 quarters memory and update cost for large maps at the price of blocky service boundaries.

inputs.name: overlapStacks
inputs.description: Whether two overlapping sources of the same service compound their effect. False (diminishing to a cap) is the genre norm and prevents station-spam strategies.

outputs.name: coverageMaps
outputs.description: Per-service grid of coverage strength in [0, 1], the authoritative answer to every 'is this cell served' question.

outputs.name: unservedCells
outputs.description: Developed cells with zero coverage from a required service, maintained as a list so advisory systems do not rescan the map.
